nodes.name: Hydrothermal Synthesis
nodes.procedure: 24 mmol Ni(NO3)2·6H2O and 24 mmol Na2MoO4·2H2O were dissolved into 360 mL deionized water and formed a transparent green solution. The solution was then transferred into a 500-mL Teflon-lined autoclave, and four pieces of nickel foam were added. After reaction at 120°C for 6 h, the nickel foam samples were taken out, washed, and vacuum dried, and NiMoO4·×H2O arrays were obtained.

nodes.name: Anodic Oxidation
nodes.procedure: The anodic oxidation process on NiMoO4·×H2O precursor was carried out in the standard three-electrode system in 1 M KOH and operated on an CHI760E electrochemical analyzer. A piece of NiMoO4·×H2O served as a working electrode, and the graphite rod and the unused Hg/HgO electrode served as a counterelectrode and a reference electrode, respectively. After carrying out CV tests in 0.924-1.724 V_RHE at a scan rate of 50 mV s^-1 for 30 cycles, black CR-NiOOH nanowire/nanosheet arrays were obtained.

nodes.characterization_summary: Potential-dependent in situ Raman of NiMoO4·xH2O shows NiMoO4·xH2O peaks decrease below 1.324 VRHE; NiOOH bands at 474 and 554 cm⁻¹ appear at 1.424 VRHE corresponding to Ni(II)/Ni(III) oxidation; MoO₄²⁻ peak at 900 cm⁻¹ from Mo dissolution.
nodes.evidence_snippet: At potentials below 1.324 VRHE, the peak intensities of NiMoO4·xH2O decrease... At 1.424 VRHE, two well-defined bands at 474 and 554 cm⁻¹ appear that belong to NiOOH... The new peak at 900 cm⁻¹ is assigned to MoO₄²⁻ in alkaline solution.

nodes.characterization_summary: Powder XRD pattern of NiMoO4·xH2O nanowires similar to CoMoO4·0.75H2O.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Its crystal structure was determined via atomic substitution and structure optimization because the powder X-ray diffraction (XRD) pattern is similar to that of the reported analog CoMoO4·0.75H2O.

nodes.characterization_summary: Disappearance of NiMoO4·xH2O peaks at ~27.3° and 29.8° demonstrates structural crack and amorphization.
nodes.evidence_snippet: With the ex situ XRD measurement, disappearance of the representative peaks at ∼27.3° and 29.8°, which belong to NiMoO4·xH2O, demonstrates its structural crack and amorphization.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiMoO4 shows unchanged Raman spectra before and after activation due to ultrathin NiOOH layer.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Raman spectra of NiMoO4 before and after activation remain almost unchanged... The undetected Raman/SAED signals of NiOOH are attributed to its ultrathin layer structure.
